name: Al Maha
positioning: Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort & Spa, Dubai: a private-pool villa resort inside the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, the UAE's first national park
best_for: Couples who want a private villa with its own pool in the desert
Travelers who want wildlife drives, falconry, camel treks and other desert experiences included in their stay

facts.text: Al Maha sits within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve.
The Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve is the UAE's first national park.
The reserve covers 225 square kilometres of unspoiled desert, about 5% of Dubai's total land area.
The resort takes its name from the Arabian oryx.
All villas are decorated with authentic and rare handcrafted Arabian furnishings, antiques and artifacts.
Each villa bathroom has a walk-in shower, a king-size bath and a his-and-hers vanity area.
Each villa includes an easel and art supplies, inspired by the surrounding desert landscape.
The Presidential Villa has a majlis displaying Arabian antiques and artifacts.
Activities range from archery, nature walks and desert drives to wildlife safaris, falconry, horse riding, camel trekking and sundowners in the dunes.
Qalb al-Sahra is a campfire evening of Bedouin traditions led by the resort's Field Experts.
The spa's signature treatments use organic ingredients inspired by Middle Eastern and Southeast Asian traditions, and it has an outdoor pool overlooking the dunes.
Al Diwaan, the signature restaurant, serves a fusion of Arabic and Mediterranean cuisine.

highlights.text: Every villa has its own temperature-controlled private pool and a wooden deck.
A stay includes two desert experiences each night.
Free-roaming oryx and gazelles live around the resort.
Al Maha Spa is a spa brand created exclusively for Al Maha.
Every guest has a dedicated Guest Relations Coordinator, who can even pre-set the temperature of the guest's pool.

considerations.text: The resort is out in the desert reserve; Dubai International Airport is about 65 km away.
